title: Open problem: Convergence of random-cluster interfaces to SLE(kappa) for q in (0,4], q not 2
body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). For the critical random-cluster model with cluster weight q <= 4 on Dobrushin domains, the exploration path converges to SLE(kappa) with kappa = 4 pi / (pi - arccos(sqrt q / 2)); known for q = 2 (Smirnov, Chelkak et al.) and, for q = 1 site percolation, on the triangular lattice only. Source: Duminil-Copin: Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice, PIMS 2017, Conjecture 3 (Schramm), p. 93.
Posed in Duminil-Copin: Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice, PIMS 2017
Current status unverified as of 2026-09-07

title: Open problem: Convergence of the parafermionic observable to (phi')^sigma for q <= 4
body:
OPEN PROBLEM (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). For the critical random-cluster model with q <= 4, the vertex parafermionic observable f_delta satisfies (2 delta)^{-sigma} f_delta -> (phi')^sigma where phi maps the domain to the strip R x (0,1) with a, b sent to -infinity, +infinity. Source: Duminil-Copin: Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice, PIMS 2017, Conjecture 4 (Smirnov), p. 94.
Posed in Duminil-Copin: Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice, PIMS 2017

title: Attempt on Convergence of random-cluster interfaces to SLE(kappa) for q in (0,4], q not 2
body:
ATTEMPT RECORD, author-checked only, from the 2026-09-07 intake. Method: Check which ingredients of the q = 2 proof are available for other q. Result: The q = 2 proof uses (i) the parafermionic observable being discretely holomorphic (full Cauchy-Riemann), (ii) RSW-type crossing estimates for tightness, (iii) identification of the limit via the martingale observable. For q in (1,4) not 2: (ii) is available (Duminil-Copin-Sidoravicius-Tassion 2017 for q in [1,4]); (iii) would follow from (i); (i) fails: for general q the observable satisfies only the contour relations (half of the Cauchy-Riemann equations), the same obstruction as in C0017. So the conjecture is reduced, for q in [1,4], exactly to finding an additional discrete relation for the parafermionic observable; the count of unknowns versus equations (one complex relation per face versus two needed) is the precise deficit. For q < 1 even RSW is unavailable. No new relation found. Obstruction: Discrete holomorphicity is only half-satisfied for q not 2.
Refers to the open problem node open-problem-c0049-convergence-of-random-cluster-interfaces-to-sle-kappa-for-q-in-0-4-q-n
